name: No Hiding Place
description:
No Hiding Place is a British television series that was produced at Wembley Studios by Associated-Rediffusion for the ITV network between 16 September 1959 and 22 June 1967.

It was the sequel to the series Murder Bag and Crime Sheet, all starring Raymond Francis as Detective Superintendent, later Detective Chief Superintendent Tom Lockhart.

videos.title: The Man Who Left His Coat
Black Fashion
videos.overview: An indiscreet love affair with a mannequin makes leading designer Richard Brent the victim of a blackmailer, who threatens to Inform his rich wife.

videos.title: Victim of the Dark
videos.overview: Nine people live in a remote country house. They are Alfred Fitch and his family. One night, the younger boy of Fitch's second marriage is murdered.

videos.title: The Last Flight of the Eel
Convict's Wife
videos.overview: Can two Dartmoor convicts serving time for a payroll snatch stop Lockhart finding out where the money is stashed?

videos.title: Epitaph for Johnnie
videos.overview: Lockhart is called in when a wealthy widow is found murdered on a Commando training beach.

videos.title: The Common Murder
videos.overview: Tragedy results when a gang of violent youths runs riot.

videos.title: The Most Beautiful Room in the World
Beware of the Weepers
videos.overview: Lockhart is on the trail of a couple of vagrants who have got their hands on some 'weeping' gelignite.

videos.title: Operation Tiptoe
videos.overview: Lockhart's investigation into a series of daring jewellery thefts is interrupted by a murder.

videos.title: A Bird to Watch the Marbles
The Best Years of Your Life
Ask Me If I Killed Her
videos.overview: A wife accuses her husband of a five-year-old murder when he runs off with another woman.

videos.title: You Never Can Tell Till You Try
The Smoker
videos.overview: A bakery manager is murdered during a robbery, and a cigarette provides Lockhart with a vital clue.

videos.title: A Home Posting
videos.overview: A gang of hapless villains try to break into a bank vault, but it all goes badly wrong.
